title: Schedule
lead: Who referees, casts and produces each upcoming match.

filters.label: Filter the agenda
filters.count: {shown, plural, one {# slot shown} other {# slots shown}} of {total}
filters.hint: “My slots”: the ones you are assigned to, provisional proposals included. “Needs cover”: a caster, producer or referee is missing (deliberate self-management excluded).

coverage.label: Coverage
coverage.hint: Complete: referee, caster and producer. Streamed: a solo caster, or a caster and a producer. Self-managed: nobody, teams manage themselves.

assignment.reasonHint: Preference: the person marked this slot. Load: they served the least in recent weeks. Calculation: proposed by the calculation, its reason is visible only to staff and the person. Provisional: proposed by the calculation, not confirmed yet.

solo.label: I stream alone (solo caster)
solo.hint: A solo caster streams without a producer; other casters need a producer for a match to be streamed.

staff.title: Calculation and confirmation
staff.hint: The calculation proposes, for a whole week, who covers each slot. Its proposals stay provisional until confirmed; staff choices are never replaced.
staff.runBody: The provisional proposals of the whole week, all tournaments included, are recalculated. Staff choices and confirmed assignments do not move.
staff.runDone: {proposed, plural, one {# proposal} other {# proposals}} across {entries, plural, one {# slot} other {# slots}}.
staff.leadLabel: Confirm what starts within the next hours
staff.confirmDone: {confirmed} confirmed, {refused, plural, =0 {none refused} other {# refused by the match}}.

settings.title: Estimated durations
settings.hint: Nobody holds two overlapping slots. A match lasts its maximum number of maps times the map duration, plus the buffer.

errors.TOO_MANY_REQUESTS: Too many actions in a row. Wait a few minutes before trying again.
errors.UNAUTHORIZED: Your session has expired: sign in again.
errors.FORBIDDEN: This action is reserved for tournament staff.
errors.NETWORK_ERROR: Cannot connect. Check your network and try again.
errors.PLANNING_ENTRY_NOT_FOUND: This slot no longer exists. The page is reloaded.
errors.PLANNING_ENTRY_CLOSED: This slot is closed: it has started or has been played.
errors.PLANNING_ROLE_NOT_HELD: This account does not hold this role.
errors.PLANNING_ROLE_CONFLICT: The same person cannot be caster and producer on one slot.
errors.PLANNING_IS_PLAYER: This person plays during this slot: they cannot cover it.
errors.PLANNING_OVERLAP: This person already holds a slot that overlaps this one: remove them from the other one first.
errors.PLANNING_OVERLAP_MANAGED: This person already holds an overlapping slot on the match itself (signed-up caster or appointed referee): remove them from that match first.
errors.PLANNING_CAST_MANAGED: This caster signed up on the match: remove them from the match.
errors.PLANNING_NOT_ASSIGNED: This person is no longer assigned.
errors.PLANNING_BUSY: Another schedule action is in progress, try again.
errors.PLANNING_CONFIRM_PARTIAL: Partial confirmation: some proposals are confirmed, the others stayed provisional after a failure. Run the confirmation again.
errors.NOT_CASTER: This account does not have the caster role.
errors.MATCH_ALREADY_COMPLETED: This match has already been played.
errors.MATCH_NOT_LAUNCHABLE: This match can no longer receive a referee.
errors.REFEREE_IDENTITY_REQUIRED: This referee must first certify their game identity.
errors.REFEREE_DISCORD_REQUIRED: This referee must first link their Discord account.
errors.REFEREE_OBJECTION: A team in the match objects to this referee.
errors.REFEREE_IS_PLAYER: This referee plays in this match.
errors.REFEREE_CHANGED: The match referee just changed. The page is reloaded.
errors.CONCURRENT_UPDATE_RETRY: The schedule just changed, try again.
errors.INVALID_CONFIRM_SCOPE: Nothing to confirm in this selection.
errors.INVALID_DURATIONS: A duration is outside the allowed range.
errors.generic: The operation failed. Try again in a moment.

staffConfirm.entryBody: The provisional proposals on this slot become assignments: the referee is set on the match.
staffConfirm.leadTitle: Confirm everything starting within {hours, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}}?
staffConfirm.leadBody: Every provisional proposal on slots starting by then becomes an assignment: referees are set on their matches.
